description:
Lactic Acid 80% Standard. It is a liquid solution in water of about 80% purity.

5 - 20% Lactic Acid would be a good place to start, as this is milder while still having excellent skin peel affects.

Uses: Treating dry, rough & scaly skin. It may also be used for other conditions as determined by your doctor.

Warnings: Dilute before use. As with all of the acids, it is important to let your skin acclimate to their use. For those whose skin is not used to the acids a slight stinging and redness may result. If this occurs, reduce usage. If irritation persists, discontinue use. This product contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use a sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterwards.

Lactic Acid is a strong Alpha-Hydroxy Acid and hence will have excellent exfoliant properties, although these are weaker than, but second only to, Glycolic Acid. AHA products should be a stand alone treatment product and not included in another product. While AHA can be included in other products there are certain incompatibilities that may arise plus AHAs (because of the pH required for best effectiveness) may not allow other products (such as cleansing masks) to work properly, and vice versa.

AHA products should have a pH of 3.5 to 4.5 for best effectiveness (Note at pH 7 AHAs are totally ineffective); while masks have a pH dependant on the function (cleansing masks with a pH of 7 to 8; moisturizing masks with a pH of 5 to 6 and some treatment masks with a pH of 4.5 to 5.5). Hence these may have incompatible pH.

If a product has some film forming agent or, in the case of masks, have materials which are not absorbed, these may reduce the absorption of AHAs. Hence reduce their effectiveness.

The product is specially formulated with 100% pure Hyaluronic Acid at a high concentration that you won't find anywhere else. It is all natural, paraben free, no artificial fragrance. It features: Paraben-free Higher concentration of HA than most other sellers Deeper skin penetration than our competitors and holds on to water, allowing the skin to better retain moisture It contains: Hyaluronic acid, also known as HA, is a natural compound found in skin that has many important functions, including holding in moisture, providing cushioning, aiding in tissue repair, holding together the skin structural components collagen and elastin, and helping create a protective barrier against microorganisms. The loss of natural hyaluronic acid is one of the causes of wrinkles, so the idea of putting HA back into the skin to repair wrinkles makes sense. Since hyaluronic acid holds moisture well -- holding up to 1,000 times its weight in water--it is a commonly used component in moisturizers. In these moisturizers, it functions not only to deliver water to the skin, but also to hold it there. As a large molecule, it doesn't permeate deep into the skin, but instead stays near the surface where it moisturizes the skin surface layers. Hyaluronic acid makes the skin look younger and increase skin tone, making it look smooth and supple. Potassium sorbate and Benzyl Alcohol Dehydroacetic Acid are very mild and natural preservatives. They have been used in many food products or produced naturally by many plants.

description: Glycolic acid peels are simply a chemical peel that features glycolic acid as the main component. Glycolic acid is currently a popular treatment for wrinkles and acne. When applied to the skin, it helps to remove the glue that holds the older, rougher and dryer skin on the surface. When it removes that top layer of skin, the fresh, new layer is visible. It’s this layer that’s without damage and which looks fresher. People who have glycolic acid peels are often amazed by the results. hey look younger, with fewer fine lines and wrinkles and if they have acne, they often notice their skin is quite a bit less oily and is much clearer. All of our glycolic peels are unbuffered, conserving their high strength and low pH level. For this reason, we strongly suggest starting at 10 percent and slowly moving up in strength as your skin adjusts to the peel. We carry glycolic acid from 10 percent to 70 percent. Step 3: Smooth ASDM Beverly Hills Pre Peel Treatment Pad over face avoiding eye and lip area Step 4: Once dry, apply chemical peel as instructed in packaging. Step 5: Leave on for 1-5 minutes. Step 6: To neutralize peel, apply several pumps of Post Peel Treatment Serum onto clean fan brush included with the packaging. Apply liberally onto face. description: Abundant in Vitamin C to help whiten skin tone and gently exfoliates the skin to remove dead skin cells. What is tamarind? If you do not live in Thailand or South-East Asia you may not know the tamarind tree (Tamarinduc indica) and the benefits of the tamarind fruit. Tamarind is a popular ingredient in Asian cuisine and Mexican food. Tamarind paste, made of the Vitamin C rich tamarind pulp, is extensively used to cook a wide range of sweet and sour flavoured dishes, sauces, and dips. But tamarind has much more to offer: its fruit pulp has been used for centuries as skin-scrubbing material to achieve smoother and lighter skin appearance. This beauty secret of tamarind has been passed down through generations in rural Thailand and may be the reason of the natural beauty and amazingly soft skin of Thai women. Nowadays, tamarind extract plays an increasingly important role in natural skin care products, commercially produced cosmetics and ointments, mainly due to its containing AHAs. What are AHAs? AHAs (Alpha Hydroxy Acids) are natural or synthetic acids that can be found in many skin care products, including facial cleanser, facial scrubs and lotions. The primary action of AHAs is to exfoliate dead skin cells by weakening bonds that hold dead skin cells together, thus resulting in skin which looks brighter, thus leading to a younger look. Tamarind & Honey Body Scrub Today, AHAs used in skin care product are often synthetically produced, mainly due to cost reasons. But synthetic AHAs have the potential to irritate the skin and it has been found that the therapeutic index (the ratio of stimulation to irritation) of the natural AHAs surpasses that of the synthetic AHAs. Therefore skin care products shall contain natural AHAs. And here the fruit pulp of the tamarind is a great source of natural AHAs. It has been proven that the fruit pulp of tamarind contains a wide range of AHAs including tartaric acid, lactic acid, citric acid and malic acid.

title: Clear - Benzoyl Peroxide 10% Acne Treatment
bullet_point: [10% Benzoyl Peroxide., Integral part of any acne treatment program., OTC that targets P.acnes, Exfoliate the buildup of excess skin deep in the follicles., Loosens impactions.]
description: Benzoyl Peroxide is an integral part of any acne treatment program. BP is a powerful oxidant which diffuses into the skin and has the ability to target the bacteria that aggravates the acne problem. BP is also used to exfoliate the buildup of excess skin deep in the follicles, suppresses irritating fatty acids, and loosens impactions - which all aid in controlling acne. Benzoyl Peroxide's action is similar to pouring hydrogen peroxide on a cut. Upon contact the BP creates bubbles and releases oxygen. The same is true of BP, but it has the advantage of using "benzoyl" - which pulls the peroxide deep into the pores. P-Acnes bacteria can not survive in the presence of oxygen, so as the oxygen is pulled deep into the pores it is killed. *While Benzoyl is wet it can cause bleaching of fabrics. If you are applying this to your back, or on your face just before bed, you may experience bleaching of your pillow case or T-shirt. Please use an old shirt and put an old cover on your pillow to test. Directions: Benzoyl Peroxide can definitely be drying - this IS the entire point. You want to have a light amount of flaking on your skin when you wake. You may use our Acne Diamond Dermabrasion Scrub to get off any flakes, or you may want to invest in our Wooden Face Brush - either will work well and keep your face smooth. You will want to apply the BP10 everywhere you are prone to acne - even if you are not breaking out at the time! *AVOID eye area. We suggest starting off using it 1x per day. or every other day. You may either leave it on all evening, or you can wash it off after 30-60 minutes. If you find that you are getting too dry then cut back to every other day and build up from there as you skin get's more tolerant.

description: A unique fragrance-free blend of alpha hydroxy acids including glycolic acid and other fruit acids that gently exfoliates. مصل ريفيتاليفت ديرم المكثف بحمض الجليكوليك النقي بنسبة 10% من لوريال باريس هو مصل لتصحيح البقع الداكنة في الليل يستخدم لتوحيد لون البشرة بشكل واضح وتقليل التجاعيد. يتم التحقق من صحة مصل الوجه بحمض الجليكوليك هذا بالتعاون مع أطباء الجلدية. حمض الجليكوليك هو حمض ألفا هيدروكسي (AHA) الذي استخدمه أطباء الجلدية على مدار عقود لإعادة ترطيب البشرة وتقشيرها وإشراقها وتوحيد لونها وحتى المساعدة في إزالة انسداد المسام التي يمكن أن تساعد على تقليل البثور. مصل حمض الجليكوليك النقي بنسبة 10% من ريفيتاليفت ديرم مركّب أيضًا من خلاصة الصبار ومستخلص نباتي ومشتق من النباتات، مشهور بفوائده المهدئة. يتم امتصاص مصل الوجه خفيف الوزن هذا بسرعة دون أي شعور لزج أو بقايا متبقية لتقليل البقع الداكنة والتجاعيد للحصول على بشرة أكثر شبابًا وأكثر تجانساً. تم اختبار مصل الوجه هذا على جميع أنواع البشرة، بما في ذلك البشرة الحساسة، ويستهدف حلول العناية بالبشرة من أجل: البقع الداكنة وتفاوت البشرة T1 ومكافحة الشيخوخة والتجاعيد. ضعي مصل حمض الجليكوليك في المساء بعد استخدام منظف الوجه وقبل وضع مرطب الوجه أو لوشن. لحماية البشرة من التعرض للشمس، استخدمي كريم الوقاية من أشعة الشمس ريفيتاليفت تريبل باور بعامل وقاية من أشعة الشمس بدرجة 30 في الصباح بعد الاستخدام. يتكون من حمض الهيالورونيك وفيتامين سي وبرو ريتينول. لمعالجة العديد من علامات الشيخوخة للعناية بالبشرة، استخدميه مع: مصل حمض الهيالورونيك النقي بنسبة 1.5% من ريفيتاليفت ديرم للوجه [يرطب ويقلل التجاعيد] ومصل فيتامين سي النقي بنسبة 10% للوجه [يفتح البشرة].

L'Oreal Paris 复颜紧致紧致 10% 纯乙醇酸精华素是一款夜间黑斑矫正面部精华,用于明显均匀肌肤 t1 并减少皱纹。 这款乙醇酸黑斑矫正面部精华经与皮肤科医生合作验证。 乙醇酸是一种阿尔法羟基酸 (AHA),数十年来一直被皮肤科医生使用,用来修复面部、去角质、提亮甚至去除皮肤t1,甚至有助于消除毛孔,帮助减少痤疮。 Revitalift Derm Intense 10% 纯乙醇酸精华素还添加了芦荟、植物萃取/植物萃取精华,以舒缓功效而闻名。 这款轻盈的面部精华可快速吸收,不会产生粘性或残留物,减少黑斑和皱纹,使肌肤更均匀、更年轻。 这款面部精华经过测试,包括敏感性,并针对皮肤护理解决方案:黑斑、不均匀的肌肤T1、抗衰老和皱纹。 晚上使用面部清洁剂和涂抹面部保湿霜或乳液之前,涂抹乙醇酸精华。 为了保护皮肤免受阳光照射,使用后早上使用 Revitalift 三重动力 SPF 30 面部防晒霜。 配方含有透明质酸、维生素 C 和视黄醇。 用于解决多种皮肤护理迹象,使用:Revitalift Derm 密集型1.5%纯透明质酸面部精华[保湿减少皱纹]和面部复颜紧致10%纯维生素C精华素[提亮皮肤]。

로레알 파리 리바이탈리프트 덤 인텐시브 10% 순수 글리콜산 세럼은 나이트 타임 다크 스팟 코렉팅 페이스 세럼으로 t1을 눈에 띄게 고르게 하고 주름을 줄이는 데 사용됩니다. 이 글리콜산 다크 스팟 코렉터 페이스 세럼은 피부과 전문의와 협력하여 검증되었습니다. 글리콜산은 피부과 전문의가 수십 년 동안 사용해 온 알파 하이드록시산(AHA)으로 피부 T1을 재생시키고 각질을 제거하며 심지어 여드름을 줄이는 데 도움이 되는 모공을 막는 데 도움이 됩니다. description: Glycolic Acid has long been a first line product of the finest spas and Dermatology offices for improving the skin. For those of you who have heard the term "Lunch Time Peel", this is the chemical used for it. Now you can do these peels at home safely and with fantastic results. After peeling your skin will be feel softer, look smoother, with improved texture and tone and reduced hyperpigmentation (sun damage). With a peel of this strength, a full course of peels (8-10 peels) are needed to see optimal results. This is a 1 fl oz (30 ml) of peel solution. Glycolic Acid is a naturally occurring chemical belonging to the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family. Derived from sugar cane, this important AHA is the smallest of the fruit acids and is able to penetrate the skin, allowing it to effectively dissolve the "glue" that holds dead cells on the surface of the skin. The dead skin cells are what cause a dull, uneven skin tone, and the blocking of pores leading to blackheads and acne. This dissolving action of the Glycolic Acid allows the dead cells to slough off, leaving behind a smoother skin surface with clear pores. This also helps stimulate collagen formation under the skins surface which helps plump up the skin from beneath, smoothing out fine surface wrinkles and superficial scars. Our 40% Glycolic Peel is a mild glycolic acid peel and is suitable for all skin types and both beginning and experienced peelers. There may be some redness right after the peel, but generally there is not much if any actual peeling unless your skin is sensitive to the peeling agent. The 40% Glycolic peel is very safe when used as directed, but is a strong, professional strength peel (pH 1.5) and should be used only as directed. As with all products, a patch test is recommended t0 see how your skin reacts to the peel. By purchasing this product, you assume all risk associated with its use and are responsible for all results either intended or unintended from using this product.

description: Glycolic acid is the best-known of a group of chemicals called fruit acids or alpha-hydroxy acids (AHA). It is derived from sugar cane. Glycolic acid works as an exfoliating agent because of its high acidity but easy solubility. When placed on the skin as part of an exfoliating cream or gel, glycolic acid goes under the damaged upper layers of skin and destroys the 'glue' which holds dead skin to the surface. As this dead skin is chemically burned off, the other ingredients carry the individual flakes away and a water rinse neutralizes the remaining acid. The result is a much-smoother skin surface and a more youthful appearance. A secondary benefit is glycolic acid's ability to draw moisturizers into the newly-exfoliated skin surface. For that reason it is recommended to use along with a moisturizer.

The Alpha Beta Medium Peel consists of 20% Salicylic Acid (Beta Hydroxy Acid) and 50% Glycolic Acid (Alpha Hydroxy Acid). The combination of BHA & AHA creates a more effective level of peel because the application of Salicylic before Glycolic allows for the acid to penetrate the skin better.


WHAT IT IS FORMULATED TO DO:
Exfoliates skin and helps to clear clogged pores, oil production, breakouts, blackheads, whiteheads. Minimizes the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and discoloration while increasing moisture retention and promoting collagen.

WHAT IS INCLUDED:
1- Salicylic 20% Peel (1oz/30ml)
2- Glycolic 50% Peel (1oz/30ml)


FOR BEST RESULTS:
Before Your Peel
Prep the skin with a daily exfoliator such as Salicylic 2%, Glycolic 10% or the Alpha Beta Daily Exfoliator Set one week prior to the peel. We strongly recommend conducting a patch test 3 days before applying a peel to ensure no negative or unusual reactions occur.


After Your Peel
Generously apply Daily Collagen Complex, Hyaluronic Serum or Squalane as needed for tight, dry skin. Use a minimum of broad spectrum SPF 30 every day to protect healing skin. Begin using a daily exfoliator in between peels for long lasting results.

DOWNTIME:
Moderate - The Alpha Beta Medium peel has mild to moderate downtime and will produce a moderate amount of peeling, similar to the peeling you would get after a moderate sunburn. The peeling will be noticeable and will normally start on day 4 or 5 and last up to 7 days.

Glycolic acid is the most active and beneficial of the Alpha-Hydroxy-Acids (AHA) used in skin care and is derived from sugar cane. Studies have shown glycolic acid to be the most effective fruit acid for cosmetic application. It has the smallest molecular structure of all AHAs, thus possesses the greatest penetration potential. Inside the cell, it stimulates the collagen and elastin fibers in the dermis, improving the appearance of wrinkles, fine lines and other forms of sun damage. It’s a fundamental part of a skin care maintenance program that will keep your skin healthy throughout the years.

description:
Skin Scripts have developed a range of cosmetic products that are targeted at keeping your skin looking young and youthful without harming your skin with dangerous toxins. We know that beautiful skin begins with healthy skin. With that in mind, we set out to discover a unique blend of ingredients that are safe for all skin types and supports the skin’s natural barrier. 

What can I expect during the treatment? Before the mandelic acid peel solution is put on your skin, your skin must be cleaned and primed. Because mandelic acid is less penetrating, it will take longer for you to feel any topical sensations. You might wonder if the peel is doing anything, but after a while, your skin should start feeling warm and turn a bit pink. The peel solution will only be left on your skin for a few minutes. It is neutralized and followed by a custom designed post peel protocol. After the peel, your skin will be pink and sensitive. Mandelic acid peels generally don't cause the skin to physically peel off (it does for some people though), but you still must take good care of your skin post-peel for it to properly heal. This means not using any scrubs, exfoliants, or harsh active treatments. It also means wearing an SPF30 to protect your skin from the sun. 

How much downtime should I expect? Because mandelic acid peels are so mild, there is very little downtime associated with the peel. Your skin may be pink, dry, and flaky in some places, but overall, the side effects from mandelic peels are easily covered up with makeup. It's still a good idea to get mandelic acid peels done on a weekend in case anything goes wrong. If you get mandelic acid peels for acne, you might experience some post-peel breakouts. As the acid exfoliates away the surface of your skin, it brings clogs you have underneath closer to the top, which may erupt as active pimples. However, the redness and irritation from the peel will subside 2-3 days.

These products are specifically designed to improve the look of aging skin that may have a dry, crinkly, or crepe-paper-like appearance. The Exfoliating Body Polish & Intensive Body Repair Treatment’s concentrated moisturizers are the perfect way to combat dry seasonal skin.

Then apply a pearl-sized amount of the Intensive Body Repair Treatment onto affected areas such as the neck, chest, arms or legs daily. Massage in a circular upward motion for up to 1 minute or until fully absorbed. Use daily.

description:
A powerful exfoliant for healthy, radiant skin, ASDM Beverly Hills Salicylic Acid peel is used to help clear and prevent pimples and skin blemishes. Topical salicylic acid is also used to treat skin conditions that involve scaling or overgrowth of skin cells such as psoriasis (a skin disease in which red, scaly patches form on some areas of the body), ichthyoses (inborn conditions that cause skin dryness and scaling), dandruff, corns, calluses, and warts on the hands or feet. Our product should not be used to treat genital warts, warts on the face, warts with hair growing from them, warts in the nose or mouth, moles, or birthmarks. It treats other skin conditions by softening and loosening dry, scaly, or thickened skin so that it falls off or can be removed easily. Salicylic acid may be used as often as several times a day or as infrequently as several times a week, depending on the condition being treated. If you are using topical salicylic acid to treat acne, your skin may become dry or irritated at the beginning of your treatment. To prevent this, you may apply the product less often at first, and then gradually begin to apply the product more often after your skin has adjusted to the medication. If your skin becomes dry or irritated at any time during your treatment, you may apply the product less often. Overall, a multi-purpose, anti-aging, preventative skin product for those looking to take control of their skin.

Unser Produkt sollte nicht zur Behandlung von Genitalwarzen, Warzen im Gesicht, Warzen mit Haarwuchs, Warzen in der Nase oder im Mund, Muttermale oder Muttermale. Es behandelt andere Hauterkrankungen, indem es trockene, schuppige oder verdickte Haut erweicht und lockert, so dass sie herunterfällt oder leicht entfernt werden kann. Salicylsäure kann so oft wie mehrmals am Tag oder so selten wie mehrmals pro Woche verwendet werden, je nach Zustand zu behandeln. Wenn Ihre Haut zu jeder Zeit während Ihrer Behandlung trocken oder gereizt wird, können Sie das Produkt weniger oft auftragen. Um esfoliante poderoso para uma pele saudável e radiante, o peeling de ácido salicílico ASDM Beverly Hills é usado para ajudar a limpar e prevenir espinhas e manchas da pele. O ácido salicílico tópico também é usado para tratar condições de pele que envolvem escamação ou crescimento excessivo de células da pele como psoríase (uma doença de pele em que remendos vermelhos, escamosos se formam em algumas áreas do corpo), ictiose (condições congênitas que causam ressecamento e escamação da pele), caspa, calos e verrugas nas mãos ou pés. Nosso produto não deve ser usado para tratar verrugas genitais, verrugas no rosto, verrugas com cabelo crescendo, verrugas no nariz ou boca, toupeiras ou marcas de nascença. Ele trata outras condições de pele suavizando e afrouxando a pele seca, escamosa ou espessa para que ela caia ou possa ser removida facilmente. O ácido salicílico pode ser usado várias vezes ao dia ou com frequência várias vezes por semana, dependendo da condição sendo tratada. Se você estiver usando ácido salicílico tópico para tratar a acne, sua pele pode ficar seca ou irritada no início do seu tratamento. Para evitar isso, você pode aplicar o produto com menos frequência a princípio, e depois gradualmente começar a aplicar o produto com mais frequência depois que sua pele se ajustar ao medicamento. Se sua pele ficar seca ou irritada a qualquer momento durante o tratamento, você pode aplicar o produto com menos frequência. Em geral, um produto de pele multiuso, antienvelhecimento e preventivo para aqueles que procuram assumir o controle da pele.

description: Glycolic acid is perhaps the best-known of a group of chemicals called fruit acids or alpha-hydroxy acids (AHA). It is derived from sugar cane, so it can be considered a natural product. Citric acid from oranges and other citrus fruits also fall under the same classification as glycolic acid. Industrial uses for this product include rust removal and degreasing, so pure glycolic acid — generally sold in concentrations of 70% or more — is extremely dangerous to exposed skin. In fact, the government considers any product with a concentration of over 10% to be a hazardous material. Most consumers know glycolic acid not from its industrial uses, but from its cosmetic ones. It is generally used as a natural skin exfoliant and moisturizer, although there is much debate over its safety and effectiveness. Some proponents suggest that products with a glycolic acid concentrations of less than 10% are practically useless. The problem is that many large-scale cosmetic producers will not increase the acid levels for fear of liability and class action lawsuits. Some smaller cosmetics companies with high-end clients do offer products with at least a 10% acid concentration. Instruction Step 1: Clean face and neck thoroughly. Step 2: Prepare skin with an alcohol/water solution (50/50 mixture). Step 3: Apply peel to face and neck area. Gently glide cotton ball unto skin, applying more pressure on areas that need added exfoliation. Step 4: Allow acid to sit on skin for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Rinse thoroughly with warm water. If needed, use neutralizing solution to neutralize acid. This step is only necessary if you feel that the acid is too strong for your skin. Otherwise, rinsing thoroughly with warm water should suffice. Step 6: Apply a good skin hydrating, healing moisturizer unto treated area. We recommend our HA serum for faster healing time and best results. Step 7: Avoid SUNBURN Step 8: Repeat peel once a week.

description: Mandelic acid is an alpha hydroxy acid derived from bitter almonds which is more gentle than Mandelic acid. Mandelic acid is a go-to anti-ageing ingredient in the world of skin care. It works to accelerate cell turnover by dissolving the tiny bonds that hold skin cells together, helping to remove dead skin on the surface of the skin that can lead to dull complexions as well as fine lines. It also strengthens collagen, one of the building blocks of the skin’s support network that gives it youthful firmness. This increased rate of sloughing thins the outermost layer of the skin called the stratum corneum. A thinner stratum corneum reflects light better and makes skin look smoother and more youthful. Mandelic acid and other alpha hydroxy acids generally soften the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and improve skin texture. Step 1: Clean face and neck thoroughly. If needed, use neutralizing solution to neutralize acid. This step is only necessary if you feel that the acid is too strong for your skin. Otherwise, rinsing thoroughly with warm water should suffice. Step 6: Apply a good skin hydrating, healing moisturizer unto treated area. We recommend our HA serum for faster healing time and best results. Step 7: Avoid SUNBURN Step 8: Repeat peel once a week.

title: Skin Obsession 50% Glycolic Acid Home Chemical peel for sun damage and lines 1 Fl Oz
description: Our Skin Obsession 50% Glycolic Acid peel is a professional quality product to help with your skin care concerns. Glycolic Acid is a naturally occurring chemical belonging to the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family. Derived from sugar cane, this important AHA is the smallest of the fruit acids and is able to penetrate the skin, allowing it to effectively dissolve the 'glue' that holds dead cells on the surface of the skin. The dead skin cells are what cause a dull, uneven skin tone, and the blocking of pores leading to blackheads and acne. Removing the cells leaves behind a glowing, youthful and beautiful complexion by removing sun damage, scars, fine lines and age spots. This also helps stimulate collagen formation under the skins surface which helps plump up the skin from beneath, smoothing out fine surface wrinkles and superficial scars. Our 50% Glycolic Acid Peel is the strongest of our glycolic acid peels and is best for people who are familiar with the peeling process. This peel is suited for tougher skin and clients who know how their skin responds to a peel. If you are new to peeling, a 20-30% Glycolic peel is more appropriate. This peel is easy to us and we include very clear instructions on how to use this peel. After you have applied the peel, your skin may be red; this is normal and will fade quickly. You may wear makeup to tone it down if you would like. About 2 days after the peel your skin may get dry and look aged, then it will start to flake and peel. This 1 fl oz (30 ml) bottle is enough peel solution for 8-10 peels at one month intervals.A patch test is required to determine sensitivity to the peel.By purchasing this product, you assume all risk associated with its use and are responsible for all results either intended or unintended from using this product.

description: Lactic acid, a type of alpha hydroxy acid, is derived from sour milk and is used for the mildest, most gentle of chemical peels. A lactic acid peel works like a glycolic acid peel, but it is much more gentle on the skin. Lactic acid functions as an exfoliant on the skin. Its acid helps dissolve the glue-like substance that binds the outermost surface skin cells together, so that old skin cells are sloughed off to reveal fresher skin cells underneath. A lactic acid peel does not come with the skin irritation or recovery time of deeper chemical peels, and it is therefore a good choice for people with sensitive skin or who have rosacea. It is also free of risks or complications, making it a good choice for those new to chemical peels.Because a lactic acid peel is so gentle, results are not as intense as with other chemical peels. A series of up to eight sessions may be required to achieve full results, with "maintenance" lactic peel treatments thereafter. Step 1: Clean face and neck thoroughly. Step 2: Prepare skin with an alcohol/water solution (50/50 mixture). Step 3: Apply peel to face and neck area. Gently glide cotton ball unto skin, applying more pressure on areas that need added exfoliation. Step 4: Allow acid to sit on skin for 2-3 minutes. Step 5: Rinse thoroughly with warm water. If needed, use neutralizing solution to neutralize acid. This step is only necessary if you feel that the acid is too strong for your skin. Otherwise, rinsing thoroughly with warm water should suffice. Step 6: Apply a good skin hydrating, healing moisturizer unto treated area. We recommend our HA serum for faster healing time and best results. Step 7: Avoid SUNBURN Step 8: Repeat peel once a week.

description: WHAT IS IT: A Jessner's peel combines 14 percent salicylic acid, 14 percent lactic acid and 14 percent resorcinol. This peel ships to you in a 30ml (1fl oz) glass amber bottle. This amount will provide 8-10 full face peels. This is a 1.2 pH medium-level peel designed for experienced users, and is suitable for most skin types. Jessner's peels have a great track record with darker skin types that normally don't respond well to peeling. The lactic acid in this peel stays on the surface of the skin where it provides exfoliation. Lactic acids have been used for centuries to renew skin tone and texture. You can find low concentrations of lactic acid in honey, papaya and citrus fruit. Lactic Acid is an Alpha Hydroxy acid that helps encourage cell turnover and stimulates collagen formation while helping to smooth and soften the skin. Resorcinol provides antiseptic properties while helping to break up the glue that holds dead skin cells together. Resorcinol is widely used to professionally treat eczema, acne and other dermatological issues. Resorcinol is an effective exfoliator that helps loosen the damaged skin layers to expose the new fresh skin beneath while also stimulating collagen to form. These ingredients combined effectively treat fine lines, acne, sun damage, dull skin, uneven complexion, rosacea, millia, age spots and superficial scarring. This is a very safe peel and is suitable for all skin types, especially those with oily or acne prone skin. Some darker skin tones, particularly African American run a small risk of post peel hyper or hypo pigmentation. As with all products, a patch test is recommended to see how your skin reacts.
